I work in HR at Inditex, and I love what I do. Alongside it, I make brand days: full-day events for our brands and teams, from the first idea to the set, the printed details and the people on the day. I work with many stores, and every project gets its own concept.

I care about quality, design and the small details. I love finding people with a craft — florists, artists, chefs — and turning what they do into master classes our teams remember.

I’m from Belarus, I speak Japanese and I practise ikebana.
